regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing, non-directional rotation with AI Infrastructure as leader (eligible, not crowded, but 'fading' val_state and mixed hurst) and Cybersecurity as challenger (crowded, crowded flag down-sizes only). Eligible fraction is modest at 0.39, and the benchmark structure is not one-narrative. The only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true), which is a de-risking/staying-power tool, not a return forecast, so leans are kept low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Cybersecurity's crowding unbinds while its durability and breadth hold — a confirmed handoff would show its rotation margin over AI Infrastructure closing while Cybersecurity stays eligible and broadened. I am not acting on crowding alone.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the rotation leader with the highest durability_bar among top eligible names (0.68), not crowded (crowding_z 0.59), and eligible under the absolute-trend gate, which is the one validated risk-control leg. The lean is a modest continuation/staying-power stance, not a return call — the rank is only a focus lens and val_state is already 'fading', so humility is warranted.
evidence: gate_helps=true for this market — trend discipline lowers drawdown
theses.dissent: val_state is 'fading' and hurst_tag is 'mixed', so the leadership may already be late-stage; the momentum rank itself has rank-IC ~0 and does not predict forward returns, so any overweight is only justified as staying-power/drawdown control.

falsifier.text: AI Infrastructure prints a lower low before 20 trading days elapse and loses its eligible (absolute-trend) status.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the rotation challenger and eligible with a high durability_bar (0.85) and full breadth (1.0), but it is crowded (crowding_z 1.8). Crowding is a size-down caution only — never a short or sell — so the lean is expressed as underweight relative to the leading theme, not a fade or negative bet.
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity has the best durability_bar and full breadth, indicating strong trend cohesion; underweighting a genuinely healthy trend because of a crowding flag risks missing continued strength, especially since crowding has no validated basket-level forward edge.

falsifier.text: Cybersecurity broadens further and its crowding_z falls below 1.0 while maintaining eligibility before the 15-day window closes.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex ranks 4th, is eligible with a durability_bar of 0.68, shows a 'trend' hurst tag (as do the related Energy equal-weight and Technology equal-weight names), and is not crowded (crowding_z 0.83). It sits inside the trend-gate discipline, which is the validated drawdown-control leg; the lean is a modest continuation read, not a forecast.
theses.dissent: Energy is only mid-table and its momentum score is far behind the leader; if the macro narrative remains AI/tech-dominant, energy may simply churn sideways rather than continue.

falsifier.text: US Energy Complex loses eligibility (absolute-trend gate) within 15 trading days or underperforms the S&P 500 benchmark by a meaningful margin.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
